Class ConsensusTreeModel

ConsensusTreeModel-class.Rd

A simple list-based S4 class, that contains a tree and associated parameters, obtained through function phylogeneticCorrelations.

Components

ConsensusTreeModel objects do not contain any slots (apart from .Data) but they should contain the following list components:

#'

  • tree the transformed consensus tree

  • params the associated consensus parameters.

tree:

the transformed consensus tree used to define the correlation structure.

params:

the parameters associated with the tree, including regularized values of the parameters.

See also

phylogeneticCorrelations, phylolmFit, PhyloMArrayLM-class.
